numeric_policy: Exact values retained; only presentation rounded. No models, APIs or new inference.

gliner_training.time_scope: three full epochs; includes checkpoints, excludes dev and teacher API; selected epoch can be earlier

limitations: Синтетические зависимые семейства, один seed; выводы описательные.
Short test1000 and long test1000 are different corpora; F1 across them does not isolate length.
Thresholds/checkpoints selected on dev; short test reused in sequential extensions.
Long reference Qwen tokens differ from actual model input tokens; NER repeat2 approaches32K.
Later long-document configurations overlapped background result copying. CPU/disk/network load was not identical; small latency differences are not isolated effects of adapter type.
Allocated and reserved are separate PyTorch measurements, not minimum VRAM. No throughput inferred from latency.
DeepSeek branch is hard-label train annotation by teacher, not soft-logit distillation or model compression.

transformations: Original source paths replaced with logical source IDs; their original SHA256 and sizes retained.
Display labels translated; numeric values, source arrays and statuses unchanged.
Exact operations timestamp removed from the background-load limitation.
not_included: Raw per-document predictions and training checkpoints
Provider API responses and private operational journals
publication_export.scope: No newly executed measurement; original completed experiments only.
